nodes.question: How can digital technologies enhance traceability in the agriculture and food sector?
nodes.answer: Digital technologies can enhance traceability in the agriculture and food sector by providing control over waste and enhancing sustainable consumption practices.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Zero hunger|Waste reduction|Food waste tracking technology_qna_001
nodes.question: How do IoT and big data technologies contribute to food waste reduction according to the comprehensive review?
nodes.answer: According to the comprehensive review, IoT and big data technologies help in tracking and analysing food waste patterns, optimizing supply chain management, and enabling better inventory management to reduce food waste effectively.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Zero hunger|Waste reduction|Food waste tracking technology_qna_002
nodes.question: What is the focus of the comprehensive review on food waste reduction based on IoT and big data technologies?
nodes.answer: The focus of the review is on exploring how IoT and big data technologies can help reduce food waste effectively.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Zero hunger|Waste reduction|Food waste tracking technology_qna_003
nodes.question: How can IoT and big data technologies contribute to reducing food waste?
nodes.answer: IoT and big data technologies can help in tracking and managing food inventory more efficiently, optimizing supply chain processes, and providing real-time data for informed decision-making to minimize food wastage.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Zero hunger|Waste reduction|Food waste tracking technology_qna_004
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How can monitoring the implementation of digital technologies help food service companies in achieving their sustainability goals?
nodes.answer: Monitoring can provide valuable data on the effectiveness of digital technologies in reducing environmental impact, improving operational efficiency, and enhancing overall sustainable practices within the food service industry.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Zero hunger|Waste reduction|Food waste tracking technology_qna_005
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How can monitoring the implementation of digital technologies help in ensuring sustainability in the food service industry?
nodes.answer: Monitoring the implementation of digital technologies can help track progress, identify areas for improvement, and ensure that sustainability goals are being met in the food service industry.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Zero hunger|Waste reduction|Food waste tracking technology_qna_006
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What are the drivers for digitalization within food supply chains to prevent food waste?
nodes.answer: The drivers for digitalization within food supply chains to prevent food waste include the need for real-time data and information, improved forecasting accuracy, enhanced communication and collaboration among supply chain partners, and increased visibility and traceability of products.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Zero hunger|Waste reduction|Food waste tracking technology_qna_007
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How are digital approaches being used to address food waste in the German food service sector during the COVID-19 pandemic as mentioned by Trotman et al. (2022)?
nodes.answer: Trotman et al. (2022) discuss the use of digital approaches to tackle food waste in the German food service sector amidst the COVID-19 pandemic, highlighting the importance of technological solutions in addressing the crisis.
